Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ أَذْهَلَنِيْ عَنْ إِقَامَةِ شُكْرِكَ تَتَابُعُ طَوْلِكَ
Translation: My God, the succession of Your favors has distracted me from thanking You

Arabic text: وَأَعْجَزَنِيْ عَنْ إِحْصَاءِ ثَنَائِكَ فَيْضُ فَضْلِكَ
Translation: And the flood of Your grace has rendered me incapable of counting Your praises

Arabic text: وَشَغَلَنِيْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ مَحَامِدِكَ تَرَادُفُ عَوَائِدِكَ
Translation: And the succession of Your benefits has occupied me from mentioning Your glories

Arabic text: وَأَعْيَانِيْ عَنْ نَشْرِ عَوَارِفِكَ تَوَالِيْ أَيَادِيْكَ
Translation: And the continuity of Your kindnesses has exhausted me from spreading word of Your good deeds

Arabic text: وَهٰذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ بِسُبُوغِ النَّعْمَاءِ
Translation: And this is the position of one who acknowledges the abundance of blessings
And has met them with shortcomings
And testifies against himself of negligence and waste
And You are the Kind, the Merciful
The Benevolent, the Generous
The One who does not disappoint those who seek Him
And does not drive away from His courtyard those who hope in Him
In Your arena, the mounts of the hopeful kneel down
And in Your field, the hopes of seekers stand
So do not meet our hopes with disappointment and despair
And do not clothe us in the garment of despondency and dismay

Arabic text: إِلٰهِيْ تَصَاغَرَ عِنْدَ تَعَاظُمِ آلاَئِكَ شُكْرِي
Translation: My God, my gratitude seems small compared to the magnitude of Your blessings

Arabic text: وَتَضَاءَلَ فِيْ جَنْبِ إِكْرَامِكَ إِيَّايَ ثَنَائِيْ وَنَشْرِي
Translation: And my praise and acknowledgment shrink beside Your honoring of me

Arabic text: جَلَّلَتْنِيْ نِعَمُكَ مِنْ أَنْوَارِ الْاِيـمَانِ حُلَلًا
Translation: Your blessings have robed me in garments from the lights of faith

Arabic text: وَضَرَبَتْ عَلَيَّ لَطَائِفُ بِرِّكَ مِنَ الْعِزِّ كِلَلًا
Translation: And the subtleties of Your kindness have placed upon me crowns of honor
And Your favors have adorned me with necklaces that cannot be untied
And have collared me with collars that cannot be broken
So Your blessings are abundant
My tongue is too weak to count them
And Your favors are numerous
My understanding falls short of comprehending them
Let alone enumerating them all
So how can I achieve proper gratitude?
When even my thanks to You requires further thanks
For whenever I say to You, "Praise be to You"

Arabic text: وَجَبَ عَلَيَّ لِذٰلِكَ أَنْ أَقولَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ
Translation: It becomes incumbent upon me to say again, "Praise be to You"
My God, as You have nourished us with Your kindness
And raised us with Your craftsmanship
Complete for us the ample blessings
And repel from us the detested punishments
And grant us from the fortunes of both worlds
The highest and most glorious, both immediate and in the future
And for You is all praise for Your excellent trials
And the abundance of Your blessings
Praise that agrees with Your pleasure
And attracts the greatest of Your kindness and generosity
O Great One, O Generous One
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy
